g.text: TWO KINDS OF AREA — TWO DIFFERENT QUESTIONS
Same classifier: FPR = 5%, power = 80%. Population prevalence = 10%.
A Population area: precision is a ratio
B ROC area: AUC measures ranking
Keep only the green + red areas (all rejections):
The bar renormalizes the 12.5% rejected to 100%.
Randomly draw one positive and one negative:
This summarizes the entire threshold curve.
It is NOT precision, accuracy, or power at one cutoff.
The small area above the ROC is ranking error,
not Type I or Type II error at the selected cutoff.
Accuracy = TP + TN = 93.5% | Negative predictive value = TN / (TN + FN) = 97.71%
Class-conditional densities each integrate to 1. Weight them by prevalence first: green tail = π·TPR; red tail = (1−π)·FPR.
